result.reason: The redline fixes the software duration at the preferred 12 months and removes the problematic calendar cutoff, but it does not reach the full playbook position. It lacks warranties that services will be performed professionally and workmanlike and that Commerce One will comply with applicable laws. The malicious-code warranty remains limited to willfully introduced code. It also applies a 12-month period to MarketSite.net Service rather than the preferred 90-day service period, ties that service warranty to acceptance of the Software, and provides only commercially reasonable correction efforts rather than an unqualified repair, replace, or refund remedy. Thus, although unrelated commercial terms are largely preserved and the margin comment accurately identifies the duration issue, the operative language is incomplete and not narrowly calibrated to the software/service distinction.
